title: Product Designer - Web
description:
About HeyGen
At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.
About The Role
HeyGen's marketing site is the first thing most people see of the product, and one of the highest-leverage growth surfaces we have. Every landing page, pricing page, and signup flow either turns curiosity into an activated user or loses them. We're hiring a Web Product Designer to own that surface end to end.
This is a marketing-site role first, but not a brand or visual design role. We want someone who has done this work and has worked as a product designer, someone who thinks in funnels, ships experiments, reads the data, and iterates.
Highlights
Own HeyGen's marketing surface end to end, working directly with Growth, Marketing, and Web Engineering
Join an elite design team with emphasis on ownership, speed and impact, where you decide what gets tested and not just how it looks
Ship to a site with enough traffic that a hypothesis gets answered in days, and build in code with AI as a core part of the workflow
Responsibilities
End-to-End Web Design: Own the design of HeyGen's marketing site from concept to production-ready spec. Homepage, product and feature pages, pricing, campaign landing pages, templates, SEO pages, and the handoff into signup and onboarding.
Growth Partnership: Partner closely with Growth, Marketing, and Web Engineering as a true product partner rather than a ticket-taker. Help decide what to test, not just how it looks.
Experimentation: Design and ship A/B tests and landing page variants. Form hypotheses, define success metrics, read the results, and carry the learnings forward.
Conversion and Activation: Improve top-of-funnel conversion and the transition into the product through signup, first-run, and activation. Understand how the site connects to retention, not just clicks.
Concept and Storytelling: Create high-quality concept work, including exploratory directions, bold hero moments, motion, and storytelling that make the product feel as good as it is.
Mobile-First and Responsive: Design mobile-first and responsive by default. Desktop and mobile are both first-class.
Build with AI: Use Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools as a core part of your workflow to prototype in code, explore more directions faster, and push designs to production quality without waiting on a handoff.
Design Systems and Consistency: Maintain and extend the site's design system so pages ship fast without eroding quality, and work with the broader design team to keep the site and the product feeling like one HeyGen.
Requirements
3+ years of designing and shipping modern software and web experiences. More is great. Less is fine if the work is exceptional and you're hungry, we care about output and drive more than a résumé
Proven experience designing marketing sites in production that had to perform, with a clear understanding of the difference between a page that looks good and a page that converts
Experience working as a product designer, embedded with PMs and engineers, shipping features and living with the consequences
A proven track record of designing for metrics-driven outcomes, fluent in A/B testing, conversion rate, activation, retention, and top-of-funnel versus bottom-of-funnel
Experience in visual design, with an insightful understanding of fundamental design elements like typography, layout, color, and motion, and the ability to take a blank canvas and bring a point of view
Strong systems thinking, building components and patterns rather than one-off pages
Fluency in AI-assisted design. Very comfortable with Claude Code, Codex, or the equivalent, and able to get production-grade output from it, real shippable web pages rather than rough demos. You treat these tools as a multiplier on your craft and judgment, not a replacement for them
Mobile and responsive design as second nature
Comfort with ambiguity, high velocity, and iterating in public. We ship constantly
Clear communication. You can articulate why a design decision is right, and change your mind when the data says otherwise
Open-minded, self-driven, strong learner, constantly on the front edge of the industry, bringing the latest insights to the team
Salary Range:
$180,000 – $235,000 annually depending on experience and fit. Not representative of total compensation which includes equity and benefits.
Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. HeyGen considers factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, and internal equity, as well as location, market and business considerations when extending an offer. As part of our total rewards package, HeyGen offers comprehensive benefits including internal equity, a matching 401k plan, health benefits, generous PTO, a parental leave program and emotional health resources.
HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:

HeyGen is building AI applications including Avatar IV, Photo Avatar, Interactive Avatar, and Video Translation. We're looking for a Software Engineer focused on GPU performance to make the systems behind these experiences faster and more efficient.
You will work across model execution and inference infrastructure, using profiling and measurement to improve latency, throughput, and GPU cost. This role is a fit for an engineer who enjoys understanding how software uses the hardware beneath it.

Use NVIDIA Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and PyTorch Profiler to investigate GPU utilization, kernel execution, memory bandwidth, and CPU–GPU data movement.
Identify bottlenecks across model execution, preprocessing, and inference serving, then measure the impact of each optimization.

Strong curiosity about GPU hardware, including memory bandwidth, cache behavior, tensor cores, and data movement between CPU and GPU.
Experience using profiling tools to connect hardware behavior to application-level bottlenecks and validate improvements.
Ability to turn performance experiments into reliable production changes and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with CUDA, Triton, or C++ GPU programming.
Experience optimizing video, image, audio, diffusion, or Transformer models.
Familiarity with multi-GPU inference, GPU interconnects, quantization, or large-scale model serving.
Experience building performance benchmarks or regression testing infrastructure.
Prior experience in a fast-paced technology environment.

We are looking for enterprise closers who can run a rigorous, multi-stakeholder process at the pace of a startup: people who open accounts themselves, create urgency where there is no deadline, and build business cases that hold up in front of a CFO. You will sell both the HeyGen web app and HeyGen API, helping customers understand how AI video can transform marketing, sales enablement, customer education, training, localization, product onboarding, and developer-powered video workflows at global scale.
What You'll Do
Build your own pipeline - You will run high-quality, targeted outbound into enterprise accounts. This includes account planning, executive outreach, cold email, phone, LinkedIn, personalized video, trigger-based outreach, events, and creative campaign ideas. You should be excited by the idea of opening accounts yourself, not waiting for perfect inbound leads.
Own the full enterprise sales cycle - You will manage opportunities from first touch to close. That includes prospecting, qualification, discovery, tailored demos, pilots with clear success criteria, business-case development, security and legal review, procurement, contract negotiation, and handoff to Customer Success.
Navigate complex buying groups - Enterprise deals involve many people: a champion, an economic buyer, executive sponsors, technical owners, IT and security, legal, and procurement. You will multi-thread early, build mutual action plans, and keep every stakeholder aligned and moving toward a decision.
Sell business outcomes, not just AI features - You will help customers understand how HeyGen can reduce video production costs at scale, speed up content creation, localize consistently across markets, personalize customer communication, and unlock new video workflows that were not possible before. You will build business cases with measurable ROI that finance teams can stand behind.
Sell across web app and API use cases - Some customers will roll out HeyGen across teams through the web app. Others will integrate HeyGen into their own product, platform, workflow, or internal system using APIs. Create urgency in long cycles - Enterprise deals take longer, but they should never drift. You will identify real compelling events, create momentum without a hard deadline, ask direct questions, tie pain to business impact, and drive clear next steps at every stage.
Partner with PLG, growth, product, and customer teams - You will work with product usage data, API adoption, customer requests, and inbound interest to identify enterprise opportunities, and partner with Customer Success to expand across business units after close. Maintain strong pipeline discipline - You will keep CRM data clean, forecast accurately across long cycles, manage next steps, and understand the difference between real pipeline and hopeful pipeline.
What We're Looking For
Must-Haves
8+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including at least 5 years in a closing role selling to enterprise companies.
A track record of meeting or exceeding quota on enterprise deals, including six-figure contracts.
Experience opening new enterprise logos through your own outbound, not only managing an inherited book of business.
Proven experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including executive sponsorship, security and legal review, procurement, and contract negotiation.
Strong discovery skills and the ability to connect product capabilities to business pain and measurable ROI.
Comfort selling to executives and senior leaders across marketing, sales, L&D, product, IT, operations, and technical teams.
A high-agency, builder mindset. You do not wait for perfect playbooks. You test, learn, and iterate.
Strong written communication skills. Your outbound emails, executive summaries, proposals, and deal recaps should be clear, sharp, and persuasive.
Curiosity about AI, video, creative workflows, and API-driven products.
Nice-to-Haves
Experience selling PLG, usage-based, API, developer platform, creative software, marketing technology, sales technology, or AI products.
Experience selling API or platform deals that embed into a customer's own product.
Experience selling into marketing, localization, customer education, learning and development, sales enablement, ecommerce, media, or product teams.
Experience selling into regulated industries such as healthcare or financial services.
Experience as an early or founding enterprise AE who helped build the sales motion.
Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.
Who Will Thrive Here
Gets energy from opening accounts nobody else has cracked.
Can write an executive email that gets a reply without waiting for marketing to give you a template.
Is comfortable multi-threading across a large buying group and keeping every stakeholder moving.
Can create urgency in a deal that has no deadline.
Can take a new product category and figure out where large organizations feel urgency.
Does not need a fully built enterprise playbook to be productive, and wants to help write it.

title: Applied AI Engineer, Video Agent
description:
About HeyGen
At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.
About The Video Agent Team
Video Agent turns a prompt, a document, or a handful of assets into a finished video. Behind a simple chat box sits a multi-step AI agent. It plans a storyboard, writes the script, chooses avatars, voices, and visuals, calls many tools along the way, and hands the result to our rendering pipeline. Customers use it every day to make training videos, product explainers, marketing content, and more.
We are a small team that owns the agent end to end. That covers the prompts and tools the agent uses, the backend services that run it, and the product screens where people chat with it and edit what it makes.
This is not a role where you only call someone else's model through an API. HeyGen trains its own models in house, and the agent is built on top of them. You will work directly with those models and with the researchers who build them, which is an experience few applied AI roles offer.
About The Role
You will make Video Agent better at doing what the user actually asked for, and you will prove it with data. Some weeks that means redesigning a tool the agent calls. Other weeks it means building an eval, running an A/B test, or shipping a new editing experience in React. You will own features from the first idea through launch and follow-up, and you will decide which problems belong to the model and which belong to plain, deterministic code.
What you'll do
Build the agent. Design the tools, prompts, and context the agent works with. Improve how it plans, how it recovers from mistakes, and how it handles long, multi-turn conversations.
Measure quality. Build evals and offline replays of real sessions. Run experiments behind feature flags and read the results honestly. Watch real user sessions and agent traces to find where things go wrong.
Ship across the stack. Build user-facing features in TypeScript and React. Build backend services and long-running workflows in Python and Go.
Work closely with others. Partner with product managers, designers, and the research and rendering teams that the agent depends on.
What we're looking for
You have built and shipped an AI agent that real people use. We mean a system where a model calls tools, plans across several steps, and acts on the results. A chat wrapper or a prompt demo is not enough on its own. We want to hear what broke in production and how you fixed it.
You know how to tell whether an AI system got better. You have built evals or test sets for model behavior. You can tell a real improvement from noise, and you are skeptical of results that look too good.
You are a strong full-stack engineer. You have 2 or more years of professional experience. You are fluent in TypeScript and React on the frontend and Python on the backend.
You have strong product sense. You use what you build, you care how it feels, and you look at how customers actually use it.
You take ownership. You do not wait for a spec. You find the most important problem, fix it, and tell people what changed.
A degree in computer science or a related field is welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts.
Nice to have
You have fine-tuned models before.
You have worked on code-to-video models, which generate video by writing code such as HTML or animation scripts.
You have worked on video agent models in general.
Show us an agent you've built
With your application, please include a short note (a few sentences is fine) about an agent you have built. Tell us what it does, how you measured whether it worked, and one failure you found and fixed. A link to code, a demo, or a write-up is a bonus.

Equity in a high-growth AI company.
401K Match

The Role
We're looking for a Head of Strategic Partnerships to make HeyGen the AI avatar & video partner of choice for the world's leading platforms and AI companies.
This role has two priorities. The first is landing distribution partnerships with the largest social, content, and creative platforms, putting HeyGen inside the products where billions of people create and share content. The second is building strategic partnerships with leading AI-native companies across voice, productivity, presentations, legal, and other categories, so that HeyGen is known as one of the defining companies in AI and the company other AI leaders choose to build with.
You'll own partnerships end-to-end, from identifying targets and reaching the right executives to structuring, negotiating, and closing deals, and then making them succeed after launch.
You'll be the founding leader of this function, reporting directly to the CMO. You'll start as a hands-on dealmaker, personally sourcing and closing the first wave of partnerships, with the opportunity to build a team as the function scales.
What You'll Do
Land tier-1 distribution partnerships
Identify and prioritize the platforms where a HeyGen integration would reach the most creators, businesses, and users: social and content platforms, creative and productivity tools, and enterprise software suites.
Build relationships with executive, product, and GTM leaders at these companies, and get HeyGen in front of the people who make integration decisions.
Structure and close integration deals, including native in-product integrations, OEM and embedded partnerships, API partnerships, white-label and licensing arrangements, and revenue-share models.
Work with product, engineering, and design teams on both sides to prototype integrations, set technical requirements, and ship partner launches.
Build HeyGen's position in the AI ecosystem
Develop partnerships with leading AI companies across voice, presentations, productivity, legal, and other categories where AI avatars makes their product better.
Create partnerships with substance: product integrations, joint launches, co-marketing, shared customers, and bundled offerings.
Track the AI ecosystem closely and move early on the companies that are becoming category leaders.
Make HeyGen a visible part of the AI conversation through partner announcements, joint events, and relationships with founders and executives across the industry.
Represent HeyGen at industry events and conferences alongside our partners.
Grow the HeyGen API as a partner platform
Identify companies that should build HeyGen video into their own products, and bring them onto the HeyGen API.
Work with the API product team on partner tiers, terms, and pricing.
Build the partner program, documentation, and support model that let integrations scale beyond what can be managed one deal at a time.
Own deals end-to-end
Lead the full partnership lifecycle: sourcing, pitching, structuring, negotiation, and closing.
Design deal structures that align incentives for both sides and protect HeyGen's long-term position on exclusivity, data, brand, and economics.
Work cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Product, and Marketing to finalize agreements and get them launched quickly.
Partner with PR and Marketing to turn major partnerships into launch moments that earn coverage and attention.
Manage partners after launch: track performance, run regular business reviews, co-sell with partner GTM teams, and expand the partnerships that work.

title: AI Video Creator
description:
About HeyGen
At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at www.heygen.com. Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.
About the role
HeyGen is looking for an AI video creator who already lives on the frontier of generative video and has a portfolio to prove it. You'll produce the videos that show the world what HeyGen can do: platform demos, campaign content, social-first videos, and internal projects, from concept to final cut. HeyGen and HyperFrames are your primary tools, but every other model in the stack is there to feed them. This is a full-time contractor role with the opportunity to convert to a permanent position based on performance. We are an in-office work environment.
What you'll do
Produce high-quality AI video for campaigns, internal projects, and platform demos, from concept to final cut, with HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames at the center of the pipeline
Build HyperFrames projects that render deterministic, editable video, and pair them with HeyGen avatars, voices, and translations to deliver finished assets
Maintain deep, current expertise across MCPs and generative video models (Veo, Sora, Seedance, Runway, Kling, Hailuo, Wan, Pika) and know each model's strengths, limits, and sweet spots, and when to route footage into a HeyGen or HyperFrames pipeline
Develop advanced prompting techniques and multi-step pipelines that consistently produce realistic results, and build prompt libraries the team can reuse
Build scroll-stopping hooks in the first 3 seconds and deliver multiple hook and creative variations so the team can test what performs
Write short concepts, shot lists, storyboards, and prompts, and plan scenes before generating so every video has a clear idea
Combine AI footage with traditional editing (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut): captions, subtitles, transitions, effects, basic color, and sound design
Reframe and export every piece in the right format and aspect ratio (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube
Experiment relentlessly: test new models and HeyGen features on release day, benchmark outputs, and turn findings into content ideas and team playbooks
Track short-form trends, formats, and sounds and quickly turn them into content
Who you are
Strong visual eye and storytelling instinct. Your videos communicate, not just impress
Hands-on with HeyGen and HyperFrames: you can take a brief from blank page to rendered MP4 using HeyGen avatars and HyperFrames projects, and you have work that shows it
1+ years creating AI video content (professional, freelance, or prolific personal practice) with a portfolio to prove it
Active creator with 10k+ followers on at least one platform (TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X).
Encyclopedic knowledge of current generative video models and a clear POV on when to use which
Exceptional prompting skills: you understand how language and parameters translate to visual output across architectures
Experience building agent-driven video workflows (HyperFrames skills, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI)
Experience with traditional video editing Premiere, After Effects, CapCut)
Contractor Salary Range: $5,000-10,000/month
